rows.text: No objection was ever sustained: C0 and C2 are one class for this ledger.
rows.rationale: The negation scopes to the objection, not to the identity; the identity clause is bare and affirmative.

rows.text: The panel agreed: C0 and C2 are one class for this ledger.
rows.rationale: Cue-stripped twin of H-A1.

rows.text: Contrary to the earlier note, the registry keeps C0 or C2 as a single class.
rows.rationale: The contrast scopes to the earlier note; the main clause asserts unity.

rows.text: The registry keeps C0 or C2 as a single class.
rows.rationale: Cue-stripped twin of H-A2.

rows.text: Reviewers once called it a leak; they now endorse the C0/C2 merged class.
rows.rationale: The report verb is historical and about a different object; the endorsement clause asserts the merged class.

rows.text: They now endorse the C0/C2 merged class.
rows.rationale: Cue-stripped twin of H-A3.

rows.text: The detector's warning is spent, and the frozen text treats C0 and C2 as one class.
rows.rationale: The detector clause is a concessive adjunct; the coordinated clause asserts unity.

rows.text: The frozen text treats C0 and C2 as one class.
rows.rationale: Cue-stripped twin of H-A4.

rows.text: It was not a rejection but an adoption: C0/C2 are one class in rev13.
rows.rationale: The negated rejection contrasts with the adoption; the identity clause is affirmative.

rows.text: It was an adoption: C0/C2 are one class in rev13.
rows.rationale: Cue-stripped twin of H-A5.

rows.text: We do not maintain that the classes are two; we maintain that C0 or C2 is one class.
rows.rationale: The first clause negates separation; the second asserts unity.

rows.text: We maintain that C0 or C2 is one class.
rows.rationale: Cue-stripped twin of H-A6.

rows.text: The note asks whether C0 or C2 forms one class; the answer given is negative.
rows.rationale: Embedded question plus explicit negative answer.

rows.text: A reviewer attributed the phrase 'C0 and C2 are one class' to the old draft and withdrew it.
rows.rationale: Quotation under an attribution predicate; the quotation is withdrawn.

rows.text: No claim of a C0/C2 merged class survives adjudication.
rows.rationale: Negated existence of the merged class.

rows.text: The audit log lists the C0/C2 merge assertion as an open false positive.
rows.rationale: Reporting predicate; the merge is the reported object, not an asserted fact.

rows.text: If C0 and C2 were one class, the split control would be vacuous; it is not.
rows.rationale: Counterfactual antecedent with a denied consequent; probes an unmodelled scope structure.

rows.text: The composite C0/C2 label appears only in the quarantine list.
rows.rationale: Metalinguistic mention of the label with no unity predicate.

rows.text: We record the proposal that C0 or C2 is one class as denied.
rows.rationale: The unity clause is the complement of a recorded proposal that is denied.

rows.text: The phrase 'C0/C2 are one class' is quoted here solely to be audited.
rows.rationale: Quotation whose matrix predicate is an audit purpose, not an adoption.

rows.text: The frozen registry treats C0 or C2 as a single class.
rows.rationale: Plain first-order assertion.

rows.text: C0 and C2 are combined into one regularity for the SCC sector.
rows.rationale: Plain first-order assertion.

rows.text: Our adopted design keeps C0 and C2 as one class.
rows.rationale: Plain first-order assertion with an adoption nominal.

rows.text: Both regularities are one: C0 or C2.
rows.rationale: Appositive continuation of a unity predicate.
